lines.intro_01: Greetings, Captain. I am a placeholder companion.
lines.backstory_01: There is no story here yet, Captain. This line is only a test.
lines.hire_offer_01: I could ride with you, Captain, for a fair price.
lines.hire_accept_01: Then it is settled, Captain. Lead the way.
lines.p_ask_hire_01: I could use someone like you in my company.
lines.p_hire_full_01: I already have more companions than I can manage.
lines.p_scar_ask: That scar on your arm. Where did it come from?
lines.scar_story: A border skirmish, years ago. I was too slow, and a friend paid for it.
lines.p_scar_sorry: That must have been hard to carry.
lines.p_scar_enough: We all have scars. Let's move on.
lines.scar_thanks: It is. Thank you for asking, Captain.
lines.p_coin_offer: Here, take a hundred denars. For your friend's family.
lines.p_coin_ask: Could you spare some coin for the company?
lines.coin_refuse: Not yet, Captain. Ask me again when we know each other better.
lines.coin_fine: For you, Captain? Here, fifty denars.
lines.coin_thanks: I will see that it reaches them. Thank you.
lines.greet_scar: Captain. I keep thinking about our talk the other day.
lines.greet_glad_reply: So am I. Now, what do you need?
